name: consumption-hud
description: Animated cyberpunk dashboard for Claude Code: track agents, tasks, tokens, context, costs and quota in a pane, from your local session transcripts.

open_at_start.title: Open the pane at startup
open_at_start.description: Opens the pane when a session starts, where the window is wide enough to dock it. /consumption always opens it.

status_line.title: Show the status line
status_line.description: Pins a line under the prompt with context, session cost and quota.

poll_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often the transcripts are re-read.

idle_after_seconds.title: Idle after (seconds)
idle_after_seconds.description: Without transcript activity for longer than this, the session is considered idle.

compare_with_deepseek.title: Compare with DeepSeek
compare_with_deepseek.description: Adds a HUD row with what the same tokens would have cost on deepseek-v4-pro at peak rates, for the session, the week and the month.
